title: North Georgia Wine Country Private Tour from Atlanta
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: The North Georgia Wine Country Tour from Atlanta is a full-day guided trip that takes you from the city into the rolling hills of Georgia’s wine region to visit several popular wineries for curated tastings. Guests typically sample a variety of wines—often 12 or more—while enjoying beautiful vineyard scenery and learning about local winemaking. The tour also includes a stop in the charming Bavarian-inspired town of Helen for shopping, dining, or sightseeing. With comfortable round-trip transportation provided, it offers a relaxing, all-inclusive way to experience the best of North Georgia’s wine country without the hassle of driving.
